sources.snippet: Model Checkpoints Relevant source files This document covers the SAM 2 model checkpoints, including the different model variants, how to download them, and how to use them with the SAM 2 predictors. Model checkpoints contain the pre-trained weights for the SAM 2 foundation model and are essential for running inference on images and videos.
